scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/domain packages/protocol packages/ui apps/daemon packages/pi-adapter packages/store && pnpm --filter @pippin/chrome-extension build && pnpm --filter @pippin/native-host build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/domain packages/protocol packages/ui apps/daemon packages/pi-adapter packages/store --pretty false && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/chrome-extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts --max-warnings=0 && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-source-limits.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
